_comment: Reviewed high/critical dependency advisories, consumed by scripts/audit-ratchet.mjs.
An advisory not listed here fails Security; a listed advisory that disappears also fails so the baseline can only shrink.

accepted.name: @expo/cli
accepted.reason: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 is inherited from Zod 3.25.76 in Expo CLI tooling; the CLI currently requires Zod ^3.25.76, so patched Zod >=4.6.6 is outside its supported range. This copy is build/developer tooling, not the shipped SPA; unblocks on an upstream Expo-compatible Zod update.

accepted.name: zod
accepted.reason: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 applies to the locked zod@3.25.76; its only consumer is @expo/cli@57.0.28, which requires zod ^3.25.76. The advisory's fixed range starts at 4.6.6, outside that semver range, so an override would be unsupported. This is Expo CLI build/developer tooling rather than SPA runtime code; unblocks on an upstream Expo-compatible Zod update.
